talk_body.author: Kindel Media
talk_body.selection: Seated upper-body performance; expressive arms visible. Hat/glasses make it unsuitable as the facial reference.

head_attention.author: Gustavo Fring
head_attention.selection: Use tracked head timing only. Do not label the source actor as listening based solely on the title.

face_expression.author: Tima Miroshnichenko
face_expression.selection: Full-face close-up for blink/brow timing; target dialogue still controls mouth.

policy: Separate quality gates and tracks per motion type. No automatic locomotion from seated video.
